# fjordrun_team_invite (Resource)

An invitation to join a team. Creating it emails the person a link, valid for 7 days. The API has no way to change an invite, so every attribute replaces it (and sends a new email).

- Once accepted, the invite stays in state with `status = "accepted"`, and destroying it does nothing: manage the membership with `fjordrun_team_member`.
- An invite that expired or was revoked leaves the state, so the next apply sends a new one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_team_invite" "ana" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  email   = "ana@example.com"
  role    = "member"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Who to invite.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Optional

- `role` (String) The role they get: `owner`, `admin`, `member` (default) or `viewer`. Only owners can invite owners.

### Read-Only

- `accept_url` (String, Sensitive) Path of the accept link, as sent by email. Only known to the state of the Terraform run that created the invite (not after an import).
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `expires_at` (String) When the invite expires.
- `id` (String) Invite ID.
- `status` (String) `pending` or `accepted`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# team_id/invite_id
terraform import fjordrun_team_invite.ana 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333
```
